onboarding.connectors.hint: Add local stdio connectors to give the assistant tools. You can skip this and set it up later in Settings.
onboarding.finish.diagnosticsHint: When enabled, you can export a support bundle from Settings. It contains only redacted paths and your active provider/model/toggles/theme — never secrets, base URLs, allowlists, or conversation content. You will see a one-time disclosure before the first export.
onboarding.finish.needCredential: Add a provider key (or pick Ollama) before continuing.
onboarding.provider.hint: Pick Anthropic/OpenAI and paste an API key, choose OpenAI-Compatible with your endpoint, or pick Ollama to run against a local model (no key needed).
onboarding.provider.stepTitle: Choose a provider and bring your key
onboarding.welcome.lede: {appName} is local-first: your conversations, attachments, and artifacts stay on this machine. Provider credentials live in the OS keychain — never in plain settings. There is no background telemetry; update checks are opt-in and you will always be asked before an update is applied.
onboarding.welcome.title: Welcome to {appName}
recovery.delete.backupOnly.body: Removes the {backupSize} backup of the store that failed to upgrade. Your fresh store and settings are not touched, and no restart is needed.
recovery.delete.backupOnly.bodyUnknownSi: Removes the saved backup of the store that failed to upgrade. Your fresh store and settings are not touched, and no restart is needed.
recovery.delete.backupOnly.title: Delete the backup only
recovery.delete.panel.title: Delete local data
recovery.delete.wipe.body: Applied on the next launch — the database is held open while {appName} is running, so the delete happens at startup. {appName} restarts immediately.
recovery.delete.wipe.confirmLabel: I understand this cannot be undone.
recovery.delete.wipe.scopeConversationsL: Conversations, attachments, artifacts, and backups. Your settings and API keys are kept.
recovery.delete.wipe.scopeEverythingLabe: Everything above plus settings, logs, and diagnostics — back to a first run. API keys stay in your OS keychain either way.
recovery.delete.wipe.title: Delete local data and start over
recovery.discardBackup.deleted: Deleted {count, plural, one {# backup file} other {# backup files}}, freeing {freed}.
recovery.discardBackup.none: No backup files were left to delete.
recovery.header.hint: You can continue right now with the fresh store — everything works, it is just empty. Restarting re-runs the upgrade from scratch, which is worth one try if the failure was transient. If you would rather not keep the backup, delete it below.
recovery.header.lede: A database migration failed at startup. To keep the app usable, {appName} started with a fresh local store. Your previous data was backed up before the reset — it is untouched and you can recover from it manually.
recovery.header.title: {appName} could not upgrade your local data
settings.appearance.language.hint: Also sets the language the assistant replies in, unless you write to it in another language.
settings.appearance.language.label: Language
